# Kinav

> Kinav is a free website and app for families arranging care for an older parent or relative in England. It lists care homes and home care providers with their latest CQC ratings, and has step-by-step guides, 30-day plans for common conditions, a benefits calculator, a care cost calculator and free letter templates. No sign-up, no ads, and nothing about the family is stored. Kinav gives general information only, not health, medical, legal or financial advice.

Useful for people in England who want to know how to arrange or pay for care for an older relative, what benefits they or their parent can claim, or how to deal with the council, the NHS or a care home.
